questions.q: What woke Black Beauty up in the night?
choices: The stable bell ringing very loud
The smell of fire in the hayloft
Ginger kicking the side of her stall
Thunder rolling from a summer storm
questions.evidence: I was suddenly roused by the stable bell ringing very loud

questions.q: Why did the squire send John to fetch Dr. White?
choices: The mistress was very ill
Joe Green had been hurt
Ginger had fallen sick
The squire had broken his leg
questions.evidence: ride for your life--that is, for your mistress' life

questions.q: What did John do at the toll-gate?
choices: Paid the man and told him to keep the gate open for the doctor
Stopped for a few minutes to let Beauty drink and get his breath
Asked the gatekeeper to ride ahead on his own horse for the doctor
Waited while the man found the key to unlock the heavy gate
questions.evidence: do you keep the gate open for the doctor; here's the money

questions.q: Why did Black Beauty need no whip or spur on the ride?
choices: He wanted to do his best for the mistress
John had left his whip at home in the hurry
The road was downhill nearly the whole way
He was in a hurry to get back to his warm stall
questions.evidence: I wanted no whip nor spur

questions.q: What time did the church clock strike when they reached Dr. White's door?
choices: Three
Midnight
Six
One
questions.evidence: The church clock struck three as we drew up at Dr. White's door

questions.q: Why did Dr. White ride Black Beauty back instead of his own horse?
choices: His horse was worn out and his son had taken the other
His horse had gone lame on a stony road the day before
He had sold his horse and had not yet bought another
John told him Beauty knew the way home better than any
questions.evidence: my horse has been out all day and is quite done up

questions.q: What did John tell the doctor about his riding-whip?
choices: He did not need it, for Beauty would go till he dropped
He should use it freely to make Beauty go a little faster
He could borrow John's own whip if he needed one on the way
He should leave it with the man at the toll-gate till morning
questions.evidence: Black Beauty will go till he drops

questions.q: What mistakes did Joe make when caring for Beauty after the ride?
choices: He left off the warm cloth and gave him cold water
He rode him out again before he had rested enough
He forgot to give him any oats or hay at all
He left the stable door wide open all night
questions.evidence: he did not put my warm cloth on me

questions.q: Beauty's lungs were attacked by "inflammation." What does that mean here?
choices: A painful, swollen sickness
A cool and healthy feeling
A special kind of horse food
A long, deep, restful sleep
questions.evidence: a strong inflammation had attacked my lungs, and I could not draw my breath without pain

questions.q: What did the master mean when he told Beauty, "you saved your mistress' life"?
choices: The doctor came just in time because Beauty ran so fast
Beauty had pulled the mistress out of a burning stable
Beauty had carried the mistress safely to the town doctor
Beauty found the mistress when she was lost on the common
questions.evidence: the doctor had said if we had been a little longer it would have been too late
